description: Get historical exchange rates for a single date or a date range, optionally for a base currency and symbols list.

date.description: Single date to get rates for, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

end_date.description: End date of the range, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

start_date.description: Start date of the range, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

symbols.description: Comma-separated list of currency codes to return rates for.

name: get_historical_exchange_rates
